blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Elgin Chantrell. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Elgin Chantrell, South Surrey and White Rock: 74 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Elgin Chantrell fell from 80 in June to 74 in October (−7.5%), and 38 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 13.0% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Elgin Chantrell?

blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

59 houses sold in Elgin Chantrell with a median price of $2,280,000 (the middle half sold between $2,094,000 and $2,534,000), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $613 per square foot, a median year built of 1995 and a median lot of 13,989 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 74 houses listed in Elgin Chantrell. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Elgin Chantrell had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Elgin Chantrell from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 38 houses sold in Elgin Chantrell over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Elgin Chantrell sell for?
faq.a: 59 houses sold in Elgin Chantrell between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,280,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: The median was 39 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.6% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
